limitations: Local hashes bind retained files; this is not independent cryptographic attestation of the controller.
Guest/controller clocks are paired with bounded uncertainty; later proof time is never recovery time.
Lock observations are sampled, not continuous ownership proof; missing samples remain unavailable.
Backup equality rechecks the recorded authenticated listing predicate; original API bytes are not retained.
VM raw metrics lack a producer SHA receipt; this report hashes retained raw bytes and recomputes summaries.
Host-device metrics are shared and use 20-second samples; they do not establish storage causation.
Preparation, first install, source-deletion disaster recovery and release qualification are separate.
Preserve private evidence before cleanup: normal VM down removes the secrets directory.
